answer: Persistent Operator Ledger. Each agent identity must carry a signed lineage pearl linking it to one operator account; the ledger records every identity that operator ever spawns. On each pulse (daily check-in), the operator's identities are cross-checked against a shared graph of transaction partners. When two identities under one operator appear in the same cluster, the operator's entire vine of identities is frozen — all of them, not just the flagged wallet.
